description: Classify 1-200 keywords' search intent from their wording: informational, navigational, commercial, transactional, or unknown. Uses the SAME wording heuristic keyword research already applies as its free-tier fallback, made directly callable for a keyword list with no research/volume data yet. FREE and purely local: no upstream call, no billing, no market dependency. Navigational detection is limited to destination/account phrasing ("login", "official website", ...) that means the same thing regardless of brand — a brand-name navigational query with no such phrasing classifies as `unknown` rather than a guessed label.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: classify_keyword_intent
